basis: SalesBlaster's email account key, as its Source context computes it for every admitted contact
rule: key(input): trim Unicode white space; lowercase by Unicode default case mapping (no locale); collapse a plus tag, replacing ^([^@+]+)\+[^@]*@(.+)$ with $1@$2; then refuse unless the result matches ^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$. No Unicode normalization and no provider-specific folding. A runtime passes when, for every vector, it returns expect.key, or refuses where expect.refused is true.
